name: SG90 micro servo mount (L bracket)
source: SG90 datasheet (ears 27.5 mm apart, 2 mm pilot holes) http://www.ee.ic.ac.uk/pcheung/teaching/DE1_EE/stores/sg90_datasheet.pdf
notes: Small flat plate 3 mm thick with a back wall 12 mm tall (y 0-3). The SG90's ear holes sit 27.5 mm apart: place the servo at (7, 5, 3) so its ears line up with m1/m2 (2 mm pilot holes for the supplied self-tapping screws). Wall holes foot1/foot2 point along Y (z=6).
